thread:
Elena (PM): dropping a quick thread for the Usage & Billing grid — new constraint: mobile parity + accessible legends. Questions: where do we surface the token breakdown on narrow viewports, and should invoice download stay per-row or global? figma: https://figma.com/file/usage-billing/mock_v6
Maya (Design): mock v6 moved the token legend to a right-side column for desktop, then collapses to a single icon trigger on widths <680px. clicking the icon opens a full-width sheet on mobile with the legend and CSV export button. :iphone:
Ben (Frontend): sheet + icon is fine. just confirm keyboard/aria patterns for the sheet and that the trigger has `aria-controls`/`aria-expanded`. popover vs sheet decision depends on mobile native feel.
Aldo (Data): billing teams asked that the stacked area order follow invoice-priority: compute, embeddings, infra. we'll add `series_priority` in the API payload. also export CSV should include: date, project_id (optional), token_type, model, tokens_consumed, cost_usd, invoice_id.
Priya (Support): one customer reported confusion: they thought the per-row "Download" pulled only that day's charges; it actually downloads the full invoice. can we change per-row label to "Download invoice" and add hover text: "This downloads the invoice for the billing period containing these charges."
Maya (Design): good call. change copy to "Download invoice" and add small helper text under the button when hovered.
a11y-bot: contrast fail on the current pastel palette for small legend text (3.6:1). recommend changing label text color to #1f2937 or using bold 14px. also suggest adding an optional patterned fill toggle for charts to help colorblind readers.
Sasha (Eng): patterned fills ok but may need a canvas fallback for performance. we can ship patterns behind an accessibility setting. also the tooltip currently queries a heavy real-time endpoint to show cache hit rates; propose swapping to pre-aggregated telemetry and prefixing the tooltip with "Estimated".
Ben (Frontend): note for implementation: lazy-render per-row invoice buttons to avoid DOM bloat; hydrate on focus or hover. will prototype virtualization with our table component.
Aldo (Data): CSV endpoint will accept {start, end, granularity, scope, series[]} and return flattened rows. I'll post an OpenAPI snippet in #api-design.
Elena (PM): UX decision: global download + conditional per-row button when invoice_exists=true. Mobile sheet should include both legend and a compact export CTA. Agree?
Maya (Design): yes. for mobile, sheet header shows date range + small export icon. legend items include color + accessible label e.g., "Compute (tokens)".
Priya (Support): please add a tooltip copy change: current token tooltip says "tokens used by this request". propose: "Estimated tokens used (prompt + response). Actual billed tokens may vary due to rounding and model fees." keeps expectation setting.
Sasha (Eng): will switch tooltip to pre-agg telemetry and update wording to include "Estimated". Also will add a rate-limit to the telemetry endpoint used by the UI.
Ben (Frontend): I'll wire up aria attributes for sheet/popover, implement lazy invoice buttons, and add the banner that appears when switching to Team scope: "Team metrics may be delayed by ~10 minutes." small, dismissible.
Maya (Design): will update figma v7 with darker label colors, right-column legend for desktop, icon-trigger sheet for mobile, and revised microcopy.
Elena (PM): action items: Maya update figma + push v7; Aldo post CSV OpenAPI; Ben start a branch for sheet + lazy buttons; Sasha swap tooltip telemetry and add rate-limit; Priya will prepare a short help center blurb to clarify invoice semantics. We'll reconvene for design sign-off next Wed. :calendar:
Maya (Design): will ping here when v7 is live. :thumbsup:
Ben (Frontend): branch started, will link PR draft later today.
Aldo (Data): OpenAPI draft to #api-design in 2 hours.
Sasha (Eng): telemetry change queued, will share infra ticket.
Priya (Support): drafting help center note now.
Elena (PM): thanks team, good progress!
